content:
Ahead of the start of the Amazon fall Prime Day early deals and alongside a particularly noteworthy $500 discount on the M5 Pro MacBook Pro, today's 9to5Toys midday digest is headlined by iPhone 17 Pro Max models that are up to $513 off and a much better value than the 18 Pro (Renewed Premium). We also have the official ecobee fall Prime Day HomeKit deals going live today with up to $210 off smart thermostats, bundles, and more, alongside a lineup of Apple accessory deals: Solo Loop bands for $7 each or less, a rare $100 markdown on the official Magic Keyboard Folio, and 40% off the official MagSafe Battery. There are tons of chargers, TVs, smart speakers, and more below.

Amazon is now offering iPhone 17 Pro Max models up to $513 off and a much better value than the 18 Pro (Renewed Premium)

We've had a handful of chances to score solid iPhone 17 Pro deals directly from Amazon, but with the fall Prime Day early deals now underway, we're seeing our first notable discounts on unlocked Renewed Premium models. While the iPhone 18 Pro Max is already available, you can now step down a generation and save over $500 on comparable specs with the 17 Pro. More below.

Right now, you can land this 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Max for $1,385.78 with free shipping. That's $213 below the original new price and a whopping $513 less than Apple's official 1TB 18 Pro Max.

Apple just launched the 1TB iPhone 18 Pro Max this month for $1,899, but while the 1TB 17 Pro Max didn't launch at quite that same price, you can now score a solid discount via Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed listing.

Only the Deep Blue model can be had directly from Amazon at this price, but other models are still well below the 1TB iPhone 18 Pro Max's price tag:

  • Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB, Cosmic Orange (Renewed): $1,499 (reg. $1,599)
  • Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB, Deep Blue (Renewed): $1,386 (reg. $1,599)

Apple's official refurbished store hasn't yet started offering the iPhone 17 series, and what we're looking at here are Amazon's highest-quality refurbished models that come backed by the full one-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and 'battery life over 90% of original' – these aren't your typical refurbished units.

Here are the current prices on Amazon's Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro lineup:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (reg. new $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (reg. new $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (reg. new $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (reg. new $1,299)

M5 Pro MacBook Pro is now $500 off at Amazon in both Silver and Space Black

There are still plenty of deals available on the latest M5 MacBook Air, but we want to circle back to this $500 discount on the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro over at Amazon – the Space Black and Silver models are both down at this price.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and 2TB of storage for $2,699 with free shipping.

That's the same all-time low price we've been tracking over the past few months, but now both the Space Black and Silver models are in stock – the latter doesn't usually go this price as frequently as the black.

Apple Solo Loop clearance sale live: $7 each, 2-packs for $10, 3-packs for $15 (reg. $49+)

To go alongside the fall Prime Day early deals, Woot just launched a full clearance sale on the official Apple Braided Solo Loop and Solo Loop bands for Apple Watch. Each band is now down to just $6.99 with free shipping for Prime members, and you can take an additional 30% off when you buy '2 or more' at checkout.

We've seen plenty of Apple Solo Loop deals over the past year, but never anything this low. Color and size selections are expected to start selling out fast, and with prices this low, it's worth grabbing a few if you've had your eye on any particular styles.

The Solo Loop normally retails for $49, so even if you just grab a single band it's a great deal. But getting 30% off when you buy 2 or more is just absurd:

  • Apple Solo Loop $7 (reg. $49+)
  • 2-pack Apple Solo Loop $10 (reg. $98+)
  • 3-pack Apple Solo Loop $15 (reg. $147+)

Colors and sizes are already starting to sell out, so we won't say too much – grab them while you can.

iPad Apple Magic Keyboard Folio on rare $100 discount at Amazon

ecobee official fall Prime Day HomeKit deals now live: up to $210 off smart thermostats, bundles, and more

We're still in fall Prime Day early mode here, but there are thousands upon thousands of deals to dig through, and ecobee has informed 9to5Toys that its official Prime Big Deal Days promotions start now. From today through October 7, you can find deals across its popular lineup of HomeKit smart thermostats as well as bundles with $200+ savings.

ecobee official fall Prime Day deals now live

These deals don't have official Prime Day tags on their listings just yet, but the prices reflect the official fall Prime Day markdowns, many of which are the same we saw during the summer Prime Day event we tracked. Outside of the major seasonal sales, this brand rarely sees discounts at this depth and selection, so if you're looking to upgrade your smart home, now's the time while the savings are still live.

This big launch deal is also joining the rest of the fall Prime Day early deals across the Fire TV Stick and streaming device lineup from $16.

Fire TV Stick fall Prime Day early deals:

All-new M6 Mac mini and Mac Studio launch deals back at Amazon (up to $50 off)

Alongside the massive $500 discount on the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro from earlier this morning, Amazon has also restored all of the launch deals on the all-new M6 Mac mini and M5 Max Mac Studio.

The new 2026 Mac mini with the all-new M6 chip, as well as the higher-end M5 Pro model Amazon carries, are both down at their lowest prices ever:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (reg. $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (reg. $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (reg. $1,299)
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (reg. $1,699)

The all-new Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM and 512GB of built-in storage also enjoys a $50 discount:

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,449 (reg. $2,499)

These aren't massive discounts per se, but for those looking to upgrade early in the launch cycle, Amazon is now the lowest place to grab one, with every configuration it carries back at all-time low prices. We wanted to make sure you didn't miss these as the new work week gets underway.
